characterization

Deposit particles on background-less silicon

Deposit the particle sample on background-less silicon. Wavelength, angular range, sampling width and scan speed belong to the following diffraction acquisition, not the deposition action. Missing fields: loading.

No separate quantity entered here; consult stocks, operations and source notes below.

02
characterization

Acquire PXRD and fit phase fractions using Jade WPF/Rietveld

Acquire PXRD and fit phase fractions using Jade WPF/Rietveld. Deposit on a background-less silicon slide and acquire Rigaku Ultima III Cu Kα diffraction in continuous scan mode with parallel-beam slit geometry. Jade 9.0 Whole Pattern Fitting/Rietveld fits unit-cell constants, background and profile parameters to estimate relative phase weight percentages. Actual refined unit-cell constants or coordinates are not supplied. Missing fields: refinement outputs, coordinate files.
